grape_black_rot.symptoms: Small reddish-brown circular leaf spots with dark margins; infected berries turn hard, shriveled, and black ('mummies').

organic_measures.name: Copper Hydroxide & Sanitation
organic_measures.method: Prune and destroy all mummified berries and infected canes. Spray copper hydroxide (2 g/L) starting early spring.

chemical_measures.name: Mancozeb 75% WP or Myclobutanil 10% WP
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Spray from pre-bloom through 4-5 weeks post-bloom.

prevention_measures: Remove all mummified fruit clusters during dormant pruning.
Maintain open canopy trellis systems (VSP) for maximum sunlight exposure.
sources: UC Davis IPM Grape Black Rot

grape_healthy.symptoms: Lush green lobed leaves, vigorous cane growth, clean fruit clusters.

organic_measures.name: Organic Soil Fertility & Foliar Zinc
organic_measures.method: Apply compost and bio-fertilizer. Spray 0.2% zinc sulphate if leaf testing indicates micronutrient need.

prevention_measures: Perform summer leaf pulling around fruit zone for air flow.
Maintain cover crop in row middles.
